scripts.repro:4-nightly: pnpm add nuxt@npm:nuxt-nightly@latest && pnpm install --force && pnpm _prep && pnpm build
scripts.repro:3-nightly: pnpm add nuxt@npm:nuxt-nightly@3x && pnpm install --force && pnpm _prep && pnpm build
scripts.repro:5-nightly: pnpm add nuxt@npm:nuxt-nightly@5x && pnpm install --force && pnpm _prep && pnpm build
scripts.reset: rm -rf node_modules .nuxt .output pnpm-lock.yaml && node -e "const f='package.json',j=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(f));j.dependencies={nuxt:'^4.1.2'};require('fs').writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(j,null,2)+'\n')" && pnpm install
